text: **What's genuinely left, and why I'm stopping here:** the actual `1.0.0` cut — real version bump, real tag, `cargo test --workspace` (supervisor-only per your CLAUDE.md, not something I run casually), and executing real `cargo publish`/`npm publish` against 61 crates + 2 npm packages. That's the one truly irreversible step in this whole chain — crate names on crates.io can't be renamed or reused once taken. I don't want to just barrel into that on your "npm whoami now works" — that told me the mechanics are unblocked, not "publish for real now."
